desc:
One of you becomes the Giant. Everyone else has a gun.

Every round, one player is picked to stomp around as a towering Giant with its own set of abilities. The rest of the server has five minutes to bring it down: three respawns, a dash, and a turret on every map. Teammates go down, you pick them back up.

👍stuff list:
- 11 Giants, each with their own kit: Magma Fiend, Werewolf, Mecha Titan, Gryphon, Anubis, Minotaur and more
- 17 guns to unlock: pistols, machine pistols, SMGs, rifles, a shotgun, snipers, an LMG
- Maps that fall apart: walls, towers and rooftops break as the Giant pushes through
- A haunted village, a carnival, a pharaoh's tomb, a frozen harbor, a castle siege and more
- Weapon skins, Giant skins, trails and finishers
- Daily rewards, quests and a level ladder that keeps unlocking new gear

Haven't been the Giant in a while? Your odds go up every round you sit out.

Join the group for a free daily chest.

💖Made with love by TRberkay and Ybs0123
